title: Showers of Blessing
lyrics_original: There shall be showers of blessing
This is the promise of love;
There shall be seasons refreshing,
Sent from the Savior above.
Showers of blessing,
Showers of blessing we need:
Mercy-drops round us are falling,
But for the showers we plead.
There shall be showers of blessing,
Precious reviving again;
Over the hills and the valleys,
Sound of abundance of rain.        ||Showers||
There shall be showers of blessing;
Send them upon us, O Lord;
Grant to us now a refreshing,
Come, and now honor Thy Word.        ||Showers||
There shall be showers of blessing:
Oh, that today they might fall,
Now as to God we’re confessing,
Now as on Jesus we call!        ||Showers||
There shall be showers of blessing,
If we but trust and obey;
There shall be seasons refreshing,
If we let God have His way.        ||Showers||

bible_verses.telugu: వారిని నా పర్వతము చుట్టుపట్ల స్థలములను దీవెనకరముగా చేయుదును. ఋతువుల ప్రకారము  వర్షము కురిపించెదను,దీవెనకరమగు వర్షములు కురియును,
bible_verses.english: I will make them and the places surrounding my hill a blessing. I will send down showers in season; there will be showers of blessing.
Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out, that times of refreshing may come from the Lord.

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవాను గూర్చిన జ్ఞానము సంపాదించుకొందము రండి; యెహో వానుగూర్చిన జ్ఞానము సంపాదించుకొనుటకు ఆయనను అనుసరించుదము రండి. ఉదయము తప్పక వచ్చురీతిని ఆయన ఉదయించును; వర్షమువలె ఆయన మనయొద్దకు వచ్చును; భూమిని తడుపునట్టి తొలకరి వర్షము కడవరి వర్షమువలె ఆయన మనయొద్దకు వచ్చును.
bible_verses.english: Let us acknowledge the Lord; let us press on to acknowledge him. As surely as the sun rises, he will appear; he will come to us like the winter rains, like the spring rains that water the earth.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for the precious promise of Your refreshing presence. While I am grateful for every drop of Your mercy, my heart longs for the deep outpouring of Your Spirit to revive my soul. Rain down Your grace upon my life, my family, and my community today. Soften any dry ground within me and fill me anew with Your joyful love. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for the precious promise of Your refreshing presence. devotional.reflection_english: Sometimes in our spiritual journey, we settle for tiny drops of grace when God longs to pour out abundant seasons of refreshing upon us. The promise of His love is not just a trickle of comfort, but a full outpouring that revives tired hearts and restores weary souls. As we sing, Jesus invites us to raise our eyes in expectant faith, trusting Him to rain down His mercy and renew our spirits. Let us open our hearts today and ask Him for the full showers of His blessing.
